Alex: Quick heads-up — kernel chooser misrouted a bunch of seqlen=8 requests into the fp8_fast path on an SM89 machine in prod-5. Observed ~2x tail latency. Anyone else see this?
Sara: Yep saw a spike on prod-5 around 02:14UTC yesterday, looked like cache thrash + kernels falling back mid-infer :grimace:
Mike: Do we have the device signature for that host? Might be driver reporting a capability flag incorrectly.
Alex: perf-bot attached a microprofile snippet, pasting key bits below:
perf-bot: ```
node: prod-5
device_id: GPU-0
sm: 89
driver: 535.54
capabilities: { tensor_cores: true, bf16: true, fp8: false }
profile: seqlen=8 -> kernel=fp8_fast (chosen)
  microbench: fp8_fast: p50=8.2ms p95=12.1ms
  expected_fastpath (bf16_short): p50=4.9ms p95=6.1ms
seqlen=128 -> kernel=bf16_long (chosen) p95=9.4ms
```
Kai: Hmm routing is picking fp8_fast because current condition checks only `tensor_cores` and `seqlen<=16`. We need an explicit `fp8_supported` flag check (driver+sm >= threshold).
Mike: Agreed. On SM89 tensor cores exist but fp8 runtime support landed in later drivers/archs. Our capability probe is conflating tensor_core presence with fp8 support.
Alex: Proposed immediate guard: require sm >= 95 && driver >= 537 && fp8_probe == true to pick fp8_fast. Otherwise prefer bf16_short for short sequences. Quick config patch: 
```
kernel_router_rules:
  - cond: "sm >= 95 and fp8_supported"
    route: fp8_fast
  - cond: "bf16_supported and seqlen <= 16"
    route: bf16_short
  - cond: "default"
    route: generic
```
Sara: +1. Please add telemetry tag `kernel_gate_v2` and a trace span `kernel_choice` so we can slice by node/driver.
Mike: Also add an event when the probe disagrees with the runtime detection: `probe_mismatch=true` so infra can alert.
Alex: I'll land the runtime guard and a unit test that simulates driver-reported capability combinations. Planning a canary to prod-5 first then 1% global.
Kai: Can we also run a quick microbench job across pools (seqlen=8,16,32) to ensure no perf regressions? Link results to the rollout PR.
Alex: Yes — I'll kick a perf-runner matrix and attach results in the PR.
perf-bot: perf matrix queued -> https://perf.internal/run/6578901234-matrix (runs: short_seq_sm89, short_seq_sm95, long_seq)
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to prod-5 at 6578902234 UTC.
Alex: Thanks all — targeting rollback if p95 increases by >10% for any slice. Will update thread with PR + perf links. :thumbsup:
